name: Orchid
rules:
Technical and a little playful: a terminal with good taste.

- Violet #6D3FC4 is the brand: bands, primary buttons, solid badges. The third mode ("green" in vibe.json) is the violet band.
- Mint #3DDC97 is the accent and gets ONE hit per shot: the caret, an underline, a key number. Text on mint is black, never white.
- The glow (violet → lilac → mint, half off-screen, drifting) is the only gradient allowed. Never behind small text.
- Type: IBM Plex Mono 600 for headlines and labels, Plex Sans for sentences, Plex Serif only for a quote. Arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic; RTL mirrors the layout.
- Headlines are typed, with the caret showing. Keep them short: mono type runs wide.
- Motion is crisp, in steps where it can be: things snap in and hold. No elastic easing.
- Never: an orange or red accent beside the violet; more than one accent colour in a shot; neon, lens flares, particle bursts.
